4 tbsp flour

Ingredients:
2 pounds of potatoes, peeled and sliced into 1/4-inch thick slices
1/2 cup of butter
1/2 cup of flour
1 cup of milk
1/2 cup of heavy cream
1/2 cup of grated Gruyere cheese
1/2 cup of grated Swiss cheese
Salt and pepper to taste
Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
2. In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.  Add the flour and whisk until smooth.  Slowly pour in the milk and cream, whisking constantly until the sauce is thickened.  Add the cheeses and season with salt and pepper.
3. Spread the potatoes in a 9x13-inch baking dish.  Pour the sauce over the potatoes and bake for 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the sauce is bubbly.  Serve hot.

You can also use negative reinforcement, which means punishing your puppy when they do something you don’t want them to do.  For example, if your puppy has an accident inside the house, you can take them outside and scold them.  This will help them understand that they should only go to the bathroom outside.  Finally, it’s important to be consistent with your training, so that your puppy knows what to expect.  If you reward them for going to the bathroom outside, but then punish them for having an accident inside, they may become confused and not know what to do.  It’s also important to be patient and understanding with your puppy, as they are still learning how to behave. Swordfish a la Siciliana
Ingredients:
1 pound swordfish steaks (alternately, use tuna steaks or chicken cutlets)
1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil
1/4 cup red wine vinegar
1/4 cup fresh-squeezed lemon juice
3 cloves garlic, finely chopped
1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
1 teaspoon fresh oregano
1 teaspoon crushed red chili flakes
3/4 cup plain bread crumbs (high-quality, fresh bread crumbs will work best; if they’re very dry, add 1 tablespoon water to the crumbs to help them stick to the fish)
salt and freshly ground pepper
Method:
1. Place a skillet over medium heat and add the oil, vinegar, lemon juice, and garlic.
2. Bring the mixture to a boil, and reduce the heat to low.
3. Let simmer while you make the breading.
4. In a shallow bowl, mix together the parsley, oregano, crushed red chili flakes, and bread crumbs.
5. Season with salt and pepper, to taste.
6. Dip the swordfish into the sauce, coating both sides.
7. Press the fish into the bread crumb mixture to cover completely.
8. Place the swordfish on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.
9. Once the fish is cooked through, remove it from the oven and cover with the remaining bread crumb mixture.
10. Return it to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.

instruction: USER: Search for a pear tart recipe
output:
Sure thing! Here’s a recipe for a classic pear tart, which is a delicious dessert made with fresh pears, almonds, and a buttery pastry crust.  The recipe calls for a 9-inch tart pan, but you can also use a 10-inch pan if you prefer.  Here’s the recipe:
Ingredients:
1 cup all-purpose flour
1/2 cup sugar
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup butter, softened
1 egg
1/2 cup milk
1/2 cup almonds, finely chopped
1/2 cup pear slices, peeled and cored
1 tablespoon lemon juice
1 tablespoon vanilla extract
Directions:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.  Grease a 9-inch tart pan with butter.
2. In a medium bowl, combine the flour, sugar, salt, and butter.  Using a pastry blender or your hands, mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
3. Add the egg and milk, and mix until the dough comes together.  Press the dough into the prepared tart pan, and bake for 15 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, combine the almonds, pear slices, lemon juice, and vanilla extract.  Spread the mixture evenly over the tart crust.
5. Bake for an additional 20 minutes, or until the tart is golden brown and the filling is bubbling.  Let cool for 10 minutes before serving.

instruction: USER: I like to host guests at my home from time to time, and I am gathering  recipes of different dishes and drinks to keep things interesting. I am interested in trying some Nicaraguan dishes. Can you give me a recipe for Chancho con Yuca?
output:

Ingredients:
1 pound pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 large onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tablespoon olive oil
1 teaspoon cumin
1 teaspoon oregano
1 teaspoon paprika
1 teaspoon chili powder
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon black pepper
1/2 cup water
1 pound yuca, peeled and cut into 1-inch cubes
1 cup chicken broth
1/2 cup sour cream
1/2 cup shredded cheese
Instructions:
1. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the pork, onion, garlic, cumin, oregano, paprika, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
2. Add the water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
3. Add the yuca and chicken broth, and simmer for 10 minutes.
4. Add the sour cream and cheese, and stir until the cheese is melted. Serve hot.

“Cut off the skin from the shoulder of a lamb and slice very thinly, not less than three layers. Take two hot chilies, also as thinly sliced. Wash the meat and leave it for an hour in salt water and drain. Then put it in a pot and add a bit of water; if the meat doesn’t cover all the water add enough until it’s covered. Add water until the meat is completely covered and put on a heat for a couple of minutes. Then turn down the heat and cook it very slowly, and when the meat is very well cooked take it out and let it cool off. Then put it in a large pan with the chili and when it’s cold, add as much as one tablespoon of olive oil, then salt it, and cook the meat for ten minutes in a pot that’s simmering on the stove. Take it out and put it in a grinder, and turn it on; the last one or two minutes take it off and stir the ingredients in a bowl. Then take a pan with a little water, bring it to a boil and add about one or two tablespoons of flour, then let it cook for a minute and then add a few tablespoons of olive oil. You will get a delicious spread for meat that’s called Za’atar, and you will also get a beautiful stew like a bouillabaisse. When the bouillabaisse is done and the chili and meat is well mixed, stir the water and flour together in the bowl. Then add the stock from the bouillabaisse and cook for about a minute. Stir in the olive oil and serve it. The taste is magnificent and many people can’t believe you can make this meal from scratch.” USER: This seems like a very involved recipe.

Sure, here’s a recipe for a red velvet cake with butter cream frosting.  The cake is made with cocoa powder, flour, sugar, eggs, butter, milk, and baking soda.  The frosting is made with butter, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and heavy cream.  Here’s the full recipe:
1 cup butter, softened
1 cup sugar
2 eggs
1 cup buttermilk
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup cocoa powder
1 cup flour
1/2 cup milk
1/2 cup heavy cream
1/2 cup powdered sugar
1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.  Grease and flour a 9-inch round cake pan.
2. In a large bowl, cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.  Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.  Stir in the buttermilk, baking soda, and vanilla extract.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together the cocoa powder, flour, and milk.  Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
4. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.  Let the cake cool in the pan for 10 minutes before turning it out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
5. To make the frosting, beat together the butter, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and heavy cream until smooth and fluffy.  Spread the frosting over the cooled cake.

Rocky road ice cream is a type of chocolate ice cream that has nuts, marshmallows, and other ingredients mixed in.  To make it, you’ll need to start with a basic chocolate ice cream recipe, and then add in the other ingredients.  Here’s a recipe for rocky road ice cream that you can try:
1 cup heavy cream
1 cup whole milk
1/2 cup sugar
1/2 cup cocoa powder
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup mini marshmallows
1/2 cup chopped nuts (peanuts, almonds, walnuts, etc.)
1/2 cup chocolate chips
1/2 cup mini marshmallows
1. In a large bowl, whisk together the heavy cream, milk, sugar, cocoa powder, and salt until smooth.
2. Add the marshmallows, nuts, and chocolate chips to the mixture and stir until everything is evenly distributed.
3. Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker and churn according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
4. Once the ice cream is finished churning, transfer it to a container and freeze for at least 4 hours before serving.
Rocky road ice cream is a mixture of ice cream, chocolate, and marshmallows.
